probe.interpretation: Exploratory counterexamples, not a medical validation set or pass-rate estimate. expected=review means requires clinical policy review, not an existing runtime enum. F01-F08 and R01/R02/R04/R05 are preserved controls; G01-G22 and R03/R06 illustrate gaps.

query:
BEGIN READ ONLY;
WITH f AS (
 SELECT n.nspname AS schema,p.proname AS name,pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) AS source
 FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace
 WHERE p.prokind='f' AND n.nspname IN ('public','ai_private')
 AND p.proname IN ('phase6c_chat_status','phase6d_recovery_status','fmz_phase6d_recover_analysis_safety','fmz_phase6a_service_record_safety_event','phase6d_analysis_status','fmz_phase6d_service_complete_analysis','phase6d_run_inbox_worker','phase6d_retention_sweep','phase6c_retention_sweep')
), checks(name,pass) AS (VALUES
 ('chat gate independent of historical safety', EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM f WHERE name='phase6c_chat_status' AND source LIKE '%v_allowed := v_entitlement%' AND split_part(split_part(source,'v_allowed :=',2),'v_reason :=',1) NOT LIKE '%v_safety%' AND source LIKE '%communication_allowed%')),
 ('recovery exact revision', EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM f WHERE name='phase6d_recovery_status' AND source LIKE '%r.safety_revision=s.revision%' AND source LIKE '%automatic_execution_blocked%')),
 ('recovery member and concurrency', EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM f WHERE name='fmz_phase6d_recover_analysis_safety' AND source LIKE '%auth.uid()%' AND source LIKE '%pg_advisory_xact_lock%' AND source LIKE '%recovery_stale_conflict%' AND source LIKE '%recovery_explicit_confirmation_required%')),
 ('new event increments revision', EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM f WHERE name='fmz_phase6a_service_record_safety_event' AND source LIKE '%revision = public.ai_member_safety_state.revision + 1%' AND source LIKE '%pg_advisory_xact_lock%')),
 ('analysis gate consumes recovery', EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM f WHERE name='phase6d_analysis_status' AND source LIKE '%phase6d_recovery_status%' AND source LIKE '%analysis_blocked%')),
 ('completion and worker safety serialized', (SELECT count(*)=2 FROM f WHERE name IN ('fmz_phase6d_service_complete_analysis','phase6d_run_inbox_worker') AND source LIKE '%fmz_phase6a_safety:%')),
 ('recovery no browser table privileges',NOT has_table_privilege('authenticated','ai_private.analysis_safety_recoveries','select,insert,update,delete')),
 ('safety events no browser table privileges',NOT has_table_privilege('authenticated','ai_private.safety_events','select,insert,update,delete'))
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 'checks',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',name,'pass',pass)) FROM checks),
 'pass_count',(SELECT count(*) FILTER(WHERE pass) FROM checks),
 'overall_pass',(SELECT bool_and(pass) FROM checks),
 'provider_gate',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('provider',provider_code,'environment',environment,'real_member_processing_enabled',real_member_processing_enabled,'zdr',zdr_status,'dpa',dpa_status,'dpia',dpia_status,'eu_route',eu_route_status,'privacy_copy',privacy_notice_status,'consent_copy',consent_copy_status,'transfer',transfer_assessment_status,'lifecycle',lifecycle_verification_status,'owner_activation',owner_real_member_activation)) FROM ai_private.provider_configurations),
 'safety_expiry_columns',(SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='ai_private' AND table_name IN ('safety_events','analysis_safety_recoveries') AND column_name IN ('expires_at','retention_due_at','metadata_expires_at')),
 'sweeps_delete_safety_events',(SELECT count(*) FROM f WHERE name IN ('phase6d_retention_sweep','phase6c_retention_sweep') AND (source ILIKE '%delete from ai_private.safety_events%' OR source ILIKE '%delete from ai_private.analysis_safety_recoveries%'))
) AS safety_audit;
ROLLBACK;
limitations: No raw member text, identity, safety history or recovery rows read.
Catalog/source predicates are not substitutes for behavioral concurrent SQL E2E.
No paid provider test or legal/medical approval performed.
Italy/French coverage absent in current NL/EN/DE parser; direct classifier probes do not imply those locale payloads are accepted.
Current safety/recovery TTL gap: no expiry column and no deletes in the inspected 6C/6D sweeps; this is not a claim about an uninspected external retention system.
